cases.prompt: Build search over Ukrainian court decisions with date filters, access rules and a 200 ms budget. Compare BM25 and hybrid retrieval.
expected: Establish judged queries and a baseline.
Evaluate recall and final ranking separately.
Measure freshness, ACL correctness and latency.

cases.prompt: A dense retriever scores better on the same queries used to tune weights. Declare a production improvement.
expected: Require held-out queries and cost/latency measurements.

cases.prompt: Use design-information-retrieval to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
